tokens.text: has connection rules for adjacent blocks

note: Lets a custom block control whether other blocks with connection behavior (fences, walls, bars, glass panes) may visually connect to it. Released alongside the new `minecraft:has_fence_connections` VanillaBlockTag.
note2: Available without the Upcoming Creator Features experimental toggle for block format versions 1.26.0 or higher.

fields.title: Connection Type
fields.description: The type of block allowed to connect to this block. Note that the "only_fences" option allows connections from all Vanilla fences excluding NetherBrick.

fields.title: Enabled Directions
fields.description: The cardinal directions that connection is enabled for. Note that if "none" is specified for "accepts_connections_from", this field will not be used.

description: Defines whether other blocks such as fences, walls, bars, and glass panes are allowed to connect to this block.
title: Block Connection Rule
